mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROWNUM NUM, P.* FROM ( SELECT * FROM POSTVIEW WHERE OWNER=#{owner} ORDER BY REGDATE DESC) P WHERE TITLE LIKE '%${keyword}%' OR CONTENTS LIKE '%${keyword}%') WHERE NUM BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT COUNT(IDX) COUNT FROM POST WHERE OWNER=#{owner} AND (TITLE LIKE '%${keyword}%' OR CONTENTS LIKE '%${keyword}%')
mapper.update: UPDATE POST SET TITLE=#{title}, CONTENTS=#{contents}, THUMBNAIL=#{thumbnail}, DESCRIPTION=#{description}, FILES=#{files} WHERE IDX=#{idx}
mapper.select: SELECT FILES FROM POST WHERE IDX=#{idx}
SELECT IDX FROM USERS WHERE BLOG=#{blog}
SELECT* FROM (SELECT * FROM USERS WHERE IDX IN (SELECT OWNER FROM POST GROUP BY OWNER) AND IDX NOT IN (#{myIdx}, #{ownerIdx}) ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE) WHERE ROWNUM <= 7
mapper.delete: DELETE LIKES WHERE PIDX=#{postIdx} AND UIDX=#{userIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) COUNT FROM LIKES WHERE UIDX=#{user}
SELECT P.IDX FROM POST P, (SELECT PIDX, UIDX FROM LIKES WHERE UIDX=#{user}) L WHERE P.IDX=L.PIDX AND P.OWNER=#{owner}

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROWNUM NUM, L.* FROM ( SELECT P.*, U.BLOG, U.PROFILE FROM (SELECT * FROM LIKES WHERE UIDX=#{user}) L INNER JOIN POSTVIEW P ON L.PIDX = P.IDX INNER JOIN USERS U ON P.OWNER = U.IDX ORDER BY P.REGDATE DESC) L) WHERE NUM BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT * FROM (SELECT P.*, U.BLOG, U.PROFILE FROM POSTVIEW P INNER JOIN USERS U ON P.OWNER = U.IDX ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE) WHERE ROWNUM<=30
